text:
maya: Quick design review — routing surface priority panel feels really dense for workspaces with >10 rules. Screenshot in thread. Can we walk through affordances and quick wins? jordan: Saw this too. Top-of-mind issues: row height, drag handle contrast, and long condition lines truncating unpredictably. Also header scroll behaviour feels off. sam: +1. Also the validation tone is aggressive. The 'No matching rule' state is styled as an error right now. Suggest copy: 'No rules matched the preview request. Try relaxing conditions.' not 'Error: no match'. taylor: Also placing the simulator toggle at the far right is weird — people expect simulation controls near the preview pane or header. Can we move 'Run simulation' next to the preview title and add a small live/one-off toggle? :thinking_face: lee: @maya a11y nit: drag handle contrast currently ~#8b8f91 on #fff which is about 2.2:1. Need >=4.5:1 for normal text/controls. Either darken to #60666a or add a stronger focus ring. maya: @lee can you paste a tiny CSS suggestion? lee: Sure — small snippet: ```css .drag-handle { color: #60666a; } .drag-handle:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0A84FF; outline-offset: 2px; } ``` taylor: Another keyboard/accessibility thing: support keyboard reordering for rules. Pattern: 'Space to pick up, arrow to move, Space to drop' and an aria-describedby that points to that instruction. sam: Example attribute: `aria-describedby="rule-reorder-instructions"` — we should expose that for screen readers when reorder mode is active. design-bot: Quick checklist added: density (row height & padding), drag affordance contrast, keyboard reorder pattern, preview toggle placement, validation tone & copy, sticky header for priority numbers. maya: Also preview updates are not announced to screen readers — when you run simulation the preview list flashes. Add `aria-live="polite"` to the preview container so changes get announced. jordan: Example: ```html
...
``` sam: Copy tweak request: change 'Invalid rule' to 'Conflicting rule' when there's an explicit conflict (and include a 'View conflict' link that focuses the conflicting rule). That reduces alarm for users when it's a minor conflict resolution suggestion. taylor: Edge case: when two rules share the same priority we currently show identical badges. Let's expose a tiny 'tie-breaker' tooltip (creation time or rule ID) instead of hiding behaviour. Helps power users debug ordering. lee: I'll file an a11y ticket with the contrast checks + keyboard reorder acceptance criteria. Anyone want to pair on test cases? maya: I can prototype grouping/collapsible stacks + sticky priority header for long lists. Will do a quick Figma prototype and a small HTML prototype to demo keyboard reorder. ETA: EOD Friday. jordan: Action items: Maya — prototype collapse groups & sticky header; Lee — file a11y ticket and add tests; Sam — update validation copy doc and add 'View conflict' action; Taylor — move preview toggle and expose live/one-off modes; I'll schedule a 20-min sync Monday to review prototype. :calendar: deploy-bot: Noted — added comment to design PR #345 and linked the accessibility ticket when it's filed. maya: Thanks all. If nobody objects I'll start with two quick mocks: compact row + expanded row, so folks can compare density tradeoffs. jordan: Sounds good. If possible show the keyboard focus state and contrast variants in the mocks. That'll speed review. :thumbsup:
